# 2014–15 Missouri State Lady Bears Basketball Team

## Overview
The 2014–15 season was another successful campaign for the Missouri State Lady Bears women's basketball program, competing in the Missouri Valley Conference (MVC).

## Coaching Staff
- **Head Coach**: Kellie Harper (née Jolly) - This was her first season as head coach after taking over the program. Harper was a former Tennessee Lady Vols star player under Pat Summitt.

## Season Performance
- The Lady Bears had a strong season, demonstrating the program's continued competitiveness in the MVC
- They maintained their reputation as one of the top mid-major programs in women's college basketball

## Conference
The team competed in the Missouri Valley Conference, traditionally one of the stronger mid-major conferences in women's basketball.

## Notable Context
- This season marked a transition period as Kellie Harper was establishing herself as head coach
- The program had a strong tradition to uphold, having been built into a powerhouse under previous coach Sharri Markovski
- Missouri State traditionally played home games at JQH Arena in Springfield, Missouri

## Legacy
The Lady Bears program has been known for:
- Regular NCAA Tournament appearances
- Strong conference performance
- Competitive mid-major program that occasionally challenges power conference teams
